candidates.change_summary: Delete the require check for msg.sender == owner, allowing anyone to call XBornID and set balances[owner] arbitrarily many times.
Replace balances[owner] = totalDistributed with balances[msg.sender] = totalDistributed so the caller's balance is set instead of the owner's.
Replace totalDistributed with totalSupply in the balance assignment, giving owner the full supply instead of the 200M distributed amount.
Insert an additional balance setting to the caller, so both owner and caller receive totalDistributed.
Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(msg.sender != owner), inverting the access control so only non-owners can execute XBornID, likely leaving balances[owner] uninitialized.
